title: Run a Local Coding AI with Ollama, Fully Offline
description:
Run a coding AI on your own machine, no cloud needed. 💻

✅ Pull a coding model with Ollama
✅ Run it with a prompt from the terminal
✅ Get code back from your own machine

Day 1 of Local AI Coding. Next up: Day 2, Chat with Your Model from the Terminal.
Follow for a new short every day and build your local AI setup.

#shorts #ollama #localai #ai #coding #programming #aitools #tutorial
comment: Local or cloud models: which would you use first? Tell me in a word! Extra tip: ollama pull downloads the model once, so after that you can run it again without downloading it.
